runtime: Isolated localhost, real app with signed local OIDC fixture and deterministic local AI playground

issues.title: One Microsoft sign-in flow for users and administrators
issues.problem: Earlier localhost evidence used local password accounts and did not demonstrate the requested SSO journey. The login link assumed a fixed provider and SSO errors did not offer a useful browser retry.
issues.fix: Use the configured provider, start SSO automatically on protected-page visits, preserve the return destination and show a safe retry after cancellation. Successful sign-out shows a neutral notice instead of immediately signing back in. No local password fields in SSO-only mode.
issues.status: Implemented; signed local OIDC flow observed, real Microsoft tenant pending

issues.title: SSO-only administration still offered local password accounts
issues.problem: Even with local authentication disabled, the Users page offered Create local user and a password-account dialog. Backend creation and reset routes did not consistently respect that mode.
issues.fix: Remove local-account creation and reset controls in SSO-only mode and reject forced browser/API commands. External identity ownership is rechecked inside password-change transactions. Retained local credentials cannot change how externally managed identities are labelled.
issues.status: Fixed; localhost UI and forced-command observations

issues.title: Explicit administrator onboarding and project delegation
issues.problem: A Microsoft identity is separate from a local administrator even when their email matches. Platform administration alone also does not confer project delegation or data access.
issues.fix: Add an offline installation-operator nomination command for a verified existing OIDC principal UUID, with preview, exclusive instance lock and audited apply. Project roles remain separately granted. The local setup administrator explicitly assigned Project Admin plus Editor to the SSO audit administrator, then signed out and local sign-in was disabled again.
issues.status: Local setup and operator preview/apply observed; no email auto-link or automatic elevation

issues.title: Chat offered dashboard creation without a grant
issues.problem: An Explorer was shown Build a dashboard even though the existing dashboard-create route denied that account. Preview/Add controls could also assume an existing builder was editable before it answered.
issues.fix: Use the same request-bound project creation permission for chat starters, preview controls and agent authoring tools. Existing dashboard edits wait for an explicit canEdit response from the exact builder frame; failed or cross-origin loads keep editing disabled and show a readable message.
issues.status: Fixed; grant, permitted creation and revocation demonstrated locally

issues.title: Agent authorization and protected metric metadata
issues.problem: Builder turn context could advertise editing for a read-only draft. Legacy restricted credentials with empty permission metadata could enter authoring preparation. Protected semantic members were omitted even when their current consumer could see them.
issues.fix: Require actual builder edit capability and reject every restricted authoring credential. Resolve protected semantic metadata through the exact principal/model/generation consumer. Expose only permitted member names, labels, types, aggregation and units; redact physical bindings, raw input, expression and filters. Mark definitions as redacted so the model does not infer hidden formulas.
issues.status: Source fixes built; local deterministic chat transport observed; production reasoning and restrictive-policy matrix unverified

issues.title: User permissions stay under administrator control
issues.problem: The requested experience needs a clear distinction between signing in, reading/exploring, creating dashboards and administering access.
issues.fix: The SSO administrator grants and removes project roles through the ordinary UI. Explorer can browse governed datasets but cannot create a dashboard. Editor enables dashboard creation while admin pages and self-grants remain denied. Removing Editor removes builder access again.
issues.status: Manual local permission flow; no user self-grant

remaining: Live Microsoft tenant sign-in remains pending the actual tenant ID, app client ID, public LeapView URL/callback and secret installed through the deployment environment or secret manager. Microsoft consent, MFA and Conditional Access were not exercised. All new authenticated screenshots use an explicitly labelled local signed OIDC provider.

The local AI playground is deterministic. Real-provider connectivity, full metric-answer quality and autonomous saved-dashboard generation are not proven by these screenshots. Protected-definition and bearer-credential changes were source-reviewed and compiled, not exercised against an exhaustive restrictive-policy matrix.

Publisher/Release Approver delegation, production publishing/delivery, payment/subscription behavior, full OAuth/desktop flows and all row/masking combinations retain their earlier unverified status. No cold-start Explorer performance fix is claimed.

Current rollout uses browser email/password login. Do not disable it in production until the real Microsoft registration, administrator access and cutover are ready. The local SSO-only exercise has ended; its temporary Editor grant was removed and fixture browser sessions signed out.

Chat creation controls reflect permission at document load; reload an already-open chat after the administrator changes its roles. Server commands independently reauthorize the current grant. The final local grant took effect and revocation returned 403; no instantaneous live-affordance update is claimed.

No new test cases, automated test suite, CI/check pass, release or merge was run for this update. Compilation and code generation were used only to run the changed local application. PR stays open for review.
